queries_run: HubSpot AI agents threat vibe coding CRM disruption 2026

findings.claim: HubSpot 10-K(FY2025)風險因子：承認競爭者可能以新AI技術使其產品失去競爭力或過時，並面對通用LLM、generative AI、通用agent及vibe coding自建軟體等非專業替代方案。
findings.excerpt: We may also face greater competition from non-specialist solutions relying on generic large language models (“LLMs”), generative AI and general-purpose agents to address a broad range of business needs.

findings.claim: 分析師(Seeking Alpha 2026-05)認為生成式AI與agent對HubSpot長期客戶成長影響有限，因自建CRM有安全與整合風險。
findings.source: Let's Data Science: Analyst Flags Limited Long-Term AI Disruption for HubSpot
